###


Release Note : UPI Autopay - Intent + TPV and QR + TPV mandates are now supported; changes to` payer_details` in the Create Mandate API


####


Deployment Date - 4th November 2026


Going forward from 4th Nov'26, you can register UPI AutoPay mandates with Third Party Validation (TPV) through the Intent and QR flows, earlier the functionality was live for only mandates registered through collect requests.


With TPV, the mandate will be registered only if the user authorises it from a bank account that the merchant have whitelisted in the request.


To support this, the` payer_details` block of the Create Mandate API changes.


Account details now go in a new` accounts` \[\] array, which takes 1 to 5 bank accounts per mandate (passing at least one account number is mandatory for TPV flow). Your end user can authorise from any one of them.


If the merchant is sending only the` account_no` as an object independently similar to` name` or` virtual_address` in the payer details it will be rejected, they will have to send this field as an object in the` accounts` \[\] array inside the` payer_details` block.
` account_ifsc` is the new field which we are adding in the` accounts` \[\] array of the` payer_details` . This is an optional field which can be passed in each item along with` account_no` .


Nothing changes for non-TPV Intent and Collect mandates, and no other Create Mandate field changes.


###


What is changing in` payer_details` ?


Field Status Type Required Rules


payer_details.accounts Added array Mandatory when` is_tpv` =` true` 1 to 5 items (at least 1 should be passed)
An empty array is rejected. Collect + TPV takes exactly 1 item.


payer_details.accounts\[\].account_no Added string Mandatory in every item for TPV flow Digits only. Must be unique within accounts\[\].


payer_details.accounts\[\].account_ifsc Added string Optional \[(Intent + TPV) & (QR + TPV) only\] Can be set per item. String, up to 11 characters (e.g. SBIN0000300). Not allowed for Collect + TPV. This field is an optional filed for TPV flow.


payer_details.account_no Deprecated string - It will be deprecated after 4th Nov 2026


payer_details.account_ifsc Added string - This is a new field which we are adding


` name` and` virtual_address` are unchanged in the payer details block.


###


When is` account_ifsc` optional?


1. For Intent + TPV and QR + TPV mandates, each account can carry an IFSC or not, independently. That means if a merchant is trying to register a mandate with TPV flow, passing the` account_ifsc` param is optional for them.
2. An item with only` account_ifsc` and no` account_no` is rejected.


Note : A request carrying both the deprecated flat field (` account_no` ) and new array` accounts` \[\] is rejected.


###


Which fields apply to which mandate type ?


Mandate type Flags name virtual_address accounts\[\].account_no accounts\[\].account_ifsc


Intent is_tpv=false, is_collect_request=false Not required Not required Not required Not required


Collect is_tpv=false, is_collect_request=true Mandatory Mandatory Not required Not required


Intent + TPV (new) is_tpv=true, is_collect_request=false, is_qr_requested=false Not required Not required Mandatory, 1–5 items Optional


QR + TPV (new) is_tpv=true, is_collect_request=false, is_qr_requested=true Do not send Do not send Mandatory, 1–5 items Optional


Collect + TPV is_tpv=true, is_collect_request=true Mandatory Mandatory Mandatory, exactly 1 item Do not send


###


Sample` payer_details` for Intent + TPV


1. Example - 1 :


```text
"is_tpv": true,
"is_collect_request": false,
"is_qr_requested": false,
"payer_details": {
"accounts": [
{ "account_no": "50100425803737", "account_ifsc": "HDFC0001234" },
{ "account_no": "23343442423" , "account_ifsc": "HDFC0001234" }
]
}


```


1. Example - 2 :


```text
"is_tpv": true,
"is_collect_request": false,
"is_qr_requested": false,
"payer_details": {
"accounts": [
{ "account_no": "50100425803737", "account_ifsc": "HDFC0001234" },
{ "account_no": "233434424234 }
]
}


```


1. Example - 3 :


```text
"is_tpv": true,
"is_collect_request": false,
"is_qr_requested": false,
"payer_details": {
"accounts": [
{ "account_no": "50100425803737"},
{ "account_no": "23343442423" }
]
}


```


1. Example - 4 :


```text
"is_tpv": true,
"is_collect_request": false,
"is_qr_requested": false,
"payer_details": {
"accounts": [
{ "account_no": "50100425803737"}
]
}


```


1. Example - 5 :


```text
"is_tpv": true,
"is_collect_request": false,
"is_qr_requested": false,
"payer_details": {
"accounts": [
{ "account_no": "50100425803737", "account_ifsc": "HDFC0001234" },
{ "account_no": "23343442423", "account_ifsc": "HDFC0001236" },
{ "account_no": "23343442424", "account_ifsc": "HDFC0001237" },
{ "account_no": "23343442425", "account_ifsc": "HDFC0001238" },
{ "account_no": "23343442426", "account_ifsc": "HDFC0001239" }
]
}


```


All other Create Mandate fields stay as documented.


###


Validation errors :


Scenario response_key


TPV mandate with no account details error_empty_payer_details


accounts sent as an empty array error_empty_accounts


More than 5 items in accounts error_accounts_limit_exceeded (new)


The same account_no appears more than once in accounts error_duplicate_account_no_in_payer_details (new)


An item with account_no missing or empty (including IFSC-only items) error_empty_payer_details


account_no has non-digits, is over 50 characters, or is sent as a number error_invalid_account_no_format (new)


account_ifsc is not a string or is over 11 characters error_invalid_account_ifsc_format (new)


Both deprecated flat fields and accounts\[\] sent error_incorrect_keys_in_payer_details


You need to make the required changes to consume the new` response_key` which are highlighted with (new) tag.


If the customer authorise from a different account: the mandate fails and you receive the existing failure callback with` error_code`` B3` .


No new callback fields are added.


###


Actions required from you :


1. The merchants who wish to use the Intent+TPV flow -


1. They need to make the changes in the payer details as stated above.
2. Integrate with accounts\[\] directly.
3. Pass the` account_no` (mandatory) and` account_ifsc` (optional) in the` accounts` \[\] array as objects inside the` payer_details` block.


2. Using Collect + TPV today: move` account_no` into` payer_details.accounts\[\]` as soon as possible. Send exactly one` account_no` and drop the field of` account_ifsc` .
3. Handle the four new response_key and the B3 failure in your mandate flow.
4. Not using TPV: no action needed.


For any further queries, please reach out to us.
